sentences.fa: به شما توصیه شده از بلند کردن اجسام سنگین خودداری کنین، می خوای کمکت کنم میزو ببری تو اتاق؟
sentences.en: You have been advised to avoid lifting heavy things; would you like me to give you a hand moving the desk into that room?

sentences.fa: نگران نباش عین آب خوردنه از پسش برمیام.
sentences.en: Don't worry. It's like a piece of cake. I can cope with it.

sentences.fa: تا حالا ۱۰ بار این کارو کردم.
sentences.en: I have already done it 10 times.

sentences.fa: شما چرا چایی بگیری وقتی من اینجام؟
sentences.en: There is no sense in serving the tea if I'm here to do it.

sentences.fa: شام می خوری؟
sentences.en: Are you eating dinner? I have just cooked the dinner.

sentences.fa: تعارف نمی کنم اشتها ندارم.
sentences.en: It's not a compliment, I haven't got appetite.

sentences.fa: می خوای کمکت کنم یخچال رو از پله ببری بالا؟
sentences.en: Would you like me to give you a hand moving the fridge up stairs?

sentences.fa: بقیشو جا ندارم.
sentences.en: I can't manage the rest.

sentences.fa: خوبی؟ انگار رنگت پریده.
sentences.en: Are you alright? You look off color.

sentences.fa: حالم خوب نیست، سرم گیج میره.
sentences.en: I'm down; I feel a bit dizzy.

sentences.fa: نمی دونم چرا معده ام درد می کنه.
sentences.en: I don't know why I have got a stomachache.

sentences.fa: می خوای کمکت کنم بلند شی؟
sentences.en: Would you like me to help you up?

sentences.fa: نمی خوام تو زحمت بندازم تو سرت شلوغه.
sentences.en: I don't want to put you in trouble; you are fully tied up yourself.

sentences.fa: برو بابا بذار کمکت کنم.
sentences.en: Come on! Let me give you a hand.

sentences.fa: شما چرا آشغالارو ببری دم در وقتي من اينجام.
sentences.en: There is no sense in putting the garbage out if I'm here to do it.

sentences.fa: از پسش بر میام.
sentences.en: I can paddle my canoe.

sentences.fa: می خوای برسونمت خونه؟
sentences.en: Would you like me to give you a lift home?

sentences.fa: نمی خوام مزاحمت بشم.
sentences.en: I don't want to inconvenience you.

sentences.fa: چه زحمتی!
sentences.en: No trouble at all!

sentences.fa: وظیفمو انجام دادم.
sentences.en: have done my duty.

sentences.fa: تو میدونی با قلب من چیکار کردی؟
sentences.en: Do you know what you have done with my heart?

sentences.fa: تو قرار بود منو بگیری، من پا به ماهم.
sentences.en: You were supposed to marry me; I'm in the family way.

sentences.fa: من ناخواسته حاملم.
sentences.en: I'm up the duff.

sentences.fa: می خوای کمکت کنم میزو بچینی؟
sentences.en: Would you like me to give you a hand setting the table?

sentences.fa: من مطمئنم نمیتونی از پسش بربیای.
sentences.en: I'm sure you can't cope with it.

sentences.fa: دارم از خجالت آب میشم شما چرا پول شامو حساب کنی وقتي من اينجام.
sentences.en: My cheeks are burning with shame; there is no sense in paying for my dinner by yourself if I'm here to do it.

sentences.fa: امشب مهمون منی.
sentences.en: It's my treat tonight.

sentences.fa: ایشالا دفعه ی بعدی!
sentences.en: Hopefully next time!
